name: the shell comment stripper stops running
edits: body = re.sub(r"(?m)(?:^|(?<=\s))#[^\n]*", " ", src)        # `#` at line start or after space

name: the suite's shell variables stop being expanded, so gates 1 and 2 vanish again
edits: for var, val in re.findall(r'^([A-Z_]+)="([^"$]+)"', text, re.M):

name: migrations stop being excluded, so the guard fires on its own premise
expect: a MIGRATION is the subject, not a gate — excluded

edits: frontier = [q for q in out if q not in seen and q.suffix in (".sh", ".py")]
expect: r2 HIGH: a file named only by ANOTHER GATE's variable is in scope

name: CI scaffolding stops being excluded, so the guard flags the fixture it certifies
expect: CI SCAFFOLDING is the subject too — the fixture that CREATES storage tables

name: the variable resolver narrows back to a single hard-coded name
edits:
rootish = {v for v, rhs in re.findall(r"^([A-Z_]+)=(.*)$", body, re.M)
                       if re.search(r"dirname|rev-parse|--show-toplevel|&&\s*pwd", rhs)}
expect: r2 MEDIUM 1: a COMPUTED root under any name still resolves

name: the file exclusion widens back to the whole scripts/ci directory
expect: only the FIXTURE is scaffolding, not its whole directory

name: the root-like PREDICATE matches everything, so any variable is stripped
expect: r3 MEDIUM: a mktemp variable is NOT stripped into a same-named repo file
